target.selection: best development checkpoint from the paused SearchQA MA-SAO arm

benchmark.name: searchqa
benchmark.adaptation: Harness-R1 code-hook protocol and same-task delta reward are retained; SearchQA replaces the paper's three AgentBench environments.

harness_evolution.candidate_semantics: A candidate patch overrides only the lifecycle hooks it names and inherits every other hook from the incumbent.
harness_evolution.reward_baseline: the current incumbent harness on identical task identities and rollout seeds
harness_evolution.acceptance: accept only a development-confirmed positive patch; merge it into the incumbent before collecting the next failure packets
harness_evolution.failure_packet_refresh: collect new failures under each newly accepted incumbent
harness_evolution.rollback: rejecting a candidate keeps the incumbent; it does not reset a previously accepted harness to h0

cold_start_sft.source: training-only silver examples selected by real same-task rerun from fresh-base candidates and validated generic seed patches

online_grpo.reward: patched average reward minus immutable baseline average reward on identical task identities and rollout seeds

post_success_algorithm_comparison.gate: Run only after standard Harness-R1 produces a syntax-valid, sandbox-valid patch with positive development gain.
methods: SAO applied to Harness Engineer weights
MA-SAO applied to Harness Engineer weights
post_success_algorithm_comparison.shared_initial_engineer: the same frozen cold-start SFT checkpoint
post_success_algorithm_comparison.shared_target: the exact frozen target model in this protocol
post_success_algorithm_comparison.shared_inputs: the same failure packets, train task identities, target rollout seeds, prompts, decoding settings, and reward definition
post_success_algorithm_comparison.shared_budget: equal target reruns and equal Engineer optimizer updates
post_success_algorithm_comparison.primary_metric: best development-confirmed cumulative harness gain over h0
secondary_metrics: held-out test gain after irreversible development freeze

rl_effectiveness.question: Does reinforcement learning make the Engineer more effective at modifying a frozen target's harness?
rl_effectiveness.primary_contrast: online GRPO versus cold-start SFT under matched proposal and target-rerun budgets
rl_effectiveness.development_acceptance_requires: positive paired question-level bootstrap 95% lower bound and at least 0.005 absolute gain
rl_effectiveness.baseline_score: freshly measure under this frozen serving protocol; historical 29.296875% is context, not a replacement for rerunning h0

nodes.dev-NDH200-025: frozen target serving, failure packet collection, and same-task reruns
